<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>Brick Breaker</title>
<style>
  body { margin:0; background:#111; display:flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; height:100vh; font-family:sans-serif; }
  canvas { background:#000; border:2px solid #444; cursor:none; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="640" height="480"></canvas>
<script>
const cv = document.getElementById('c'), ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
const W = cv.width, H = cv.height;
const LEVELS = [
  ["..........","1111111111","2222222222","3333333333"],
  ["3.3.3.3.3.","2222222222","1.1111111.1","3333333333","2.2.2.2.2."]
];
const COLORS = {1:'#4caf50',2:'#2196f3',3:'#e91e63'};
const COLS = 10, BW = 60, BH = 20, GAP = 4, OX = (W - COLS*(BW+GAP)+GAP)/2, OY = 50;
let paddle, ball, bricks, score, lives, level, state, keys = {};

function reset() { score = 0; lives = 3; level = 0; loadLevel(); state = 'start'; }
function loadLevel() {
  bricks = [];
  LEVELS[level].forEach((row, r) => {
    for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
      const ch = row[c];
      if (ch && ch !== '.') bricks.push({x: OX + c*(BW+GAP), y: OY + r*(BH+GAP), hp: +ch, pts: +ch*10});
    }
  });
  resetBall();
}
function resetBall() {
  paddle = {w: 90, h: 12, x: W/2 - 45, y: H - 30};
  ball = {x: W/2, y: H - 40, r: 7, vx: 0, vy: 0, stuck: true};
}
function launch() {
  if (state === 'start' || state === 'between') state = 'play';
  else if (state === 'over' || state === 'win') { reset(); state = 'play'; }
  if (state === 'play' && ball.stuck) {
    const sp = 5 + level;
    ball.vx = sp * (Math.random() * 0.8 - 0.4); ball.vy = -sp; ball.stuck = false;
  }
}

document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  keys[e.key] = true;
  if (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); launch(); }
});
document.addEventListener('keyup', e => keys[e.key] = false);
cv.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
  const rect = cv.getBoundingClientRect();
  paddle.x = (e.clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width) - paddle.w/2;
});
cv.addEventListener('click', launch);

function update() {
  if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a']) paddle.x -= 8;
  if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) paddle.x += 8;
  paddle.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - paddle.w, paddle.x));
  if (ball.stuck) { ball.x = paddle.x + paddle.w/2; ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r; return; }
  if (state !== 'play') return;
  ball.x += ball.vx; ball.y += ball.vy;
  if (ball.x < ball.r) { ball.x = ball.r; ball.vx *= -1; }
  if (ball.x > W - ball.r) { ball.x = W - ball.r; ball.vx *= -1; }
  if (ball.y < ball.r) { ball.y = ball.r; ball.vy *= -1; }
  if (ball.vy > 0 && ball.y + ball.r >= paddle.y && ball.y - ball.r <= paddle.y + paddle.h &&
      ball.x >= paddle.x - ball.r && ball.x <= paddle.x + paddle.w + ball.r) {
    const sp = Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy);
    const hit = ((ball.x - paddle.x) / paddle.w - 0.5) * 2;
    const ang = hit * Math.PI / 3;
    ball.vx = sp * Math.sin(ang); ball.vy = -sp * Math.cos(ang);
    ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r;
  }
  for (const b of bricks) {
    if (b.hp <= 0) continue;
    const cx = Math.max(b.x, Math.min(ball.x, b.x + BW)), cy = Math.max(b.y, Math.min(ball.y, b.y + BH));
    const dx = ball.x - cx, dy = ball.y - cy;
    if (dx*dx + dy*dy <= ball.r*ball.r) {
      if (Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy)) ball.vx *= -1; else ball.vy *= -1;
      b.hp--; if (b.hp <= 0) score += b.pts; else score += 5;
      break;
    }
  }
  if (bricks.every(b => b.hp <= 0)) {
    if (level < LEVELS.length - 1) { level++; loadLevel(); state = 'between'; }
    else state = 'win';
  }
  if (ball.y > H + ball.r) {
    lives--;
    if (lives <= 0) state = 'over'; else resetBall();
  }
}

function text(t, y, size = 28) {
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff'; ctx.font = size + 'px sans-serif'; ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.fillText(t, W/2, y);
}
function draw() {
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
  for (const b of bricks) {
    if (b.hp <= 0) continue;
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS[b.hp]; ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, BW, BH);
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ddd'; ctx.fillRect(paddle.x, paddle.y, paddle.w, paddle.h);
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fillStyle = '#ffeb3b'; ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff'; ctx.font = '18px sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left'; ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 25);
  ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.fillText('Level ' + (level + 1) + '/' + LEVELS.length, W/2, 25);
  ctx.textAlign = 'right'; ctx.fillText('Lives: ' + '♥'.repeat(lives), W - 10, 25);
  if (state === 'start') { text('BRICK BREAKER', H/2); text('Move: mouse or ←/→ (A/D) · Launch: click or Space', H/2 + 35, 16); }
  else if (state === 'between') text('Level ' + (level + 1) + '! Click or Space to start', H/2 + 40, 22);
  else if (state === 'over') { text('GAME OVER', H/2 + 40); text('Click or Space to restart', H/2 + 75, 16); }
  else if (state === 'win') { text('YOU WIN! Score: ' + score, H/2 + 40); text('Click or Space to play again', H/2 + 75, 16); }
  else if (ball.stuck) text('Click or Space to launch', H/2 + 40, 16);
}
function loop() { update(); draw(); requestAnimationFrame(loop); }
reset(); loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>

I wrote `index.html` in the current folder, a single-file brick-breaker game. I haven't opened it in a browser, so it hasn't been play-tested.

- **Controls:** move the paddle with the mouse or the arrow keys (A/D also work). Click or press Space/Enter to launch the ball, start the next level, or restart.
- **Levels:** there are 2. In level 2 the ball is faster and the layout is different. Some bricks take more than one hit, shown by color: pink takes 3, blue 2, green 1.
- **Score and lives:** the score, the current level and 3 lives (shown as hearts) appear across the top. Missing the ball costs a life. The game ends with a "Game Over" screen when lives run out, or a "You Win" screen after level 2.
- **Aiming:** where the ball hits the paddle sets its bounce angle, so you can steer it.
